thought.text: 14/14 endpoints green. Let me confirm RabbitMQ and MinIO (the awk filters missed them):

reasoning_content: All 14 endpoints are OK, 0 failures. PostgreSQL is online, 3 Tomcat instances are running. The reason the RabbitMQ and MinIO lines weren't displayed is that rabbitmqctl needs environment variables, and the ss output format may have been different. Let me quickly re-verify those two individually, and then wrap up.

action.command:
export RABBITMQ_NODENAME=rabbit@localhost RABBITMQ_NODE_IP_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1; rabbitmqctl status 2>/dev/null | grep -E "RabbitMQ version|Uptime" | head -2
rabbitmqctl list_queues -q 2>/dev/null | tail -2
ss -tln | grep -E ":9000|:9001|:8090" | head -4
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xplanbox AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xplanbox; aws --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:9000 s3 ls 2>/dev/null
ps aux | grep "[v]alidator-executor" | wc -l
